description: Generate a formatted citation for a source in five styles (APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, IEEE) from the source type and details. Requires a student email. Free. Use it when a student needs to cite a book, journal article, website, or other source for an essay or paper.

authors.description: Author names as a list, e.g. ["Smith, J.", "Doe, A."].

type.description: Source type: book, journal, website, newspaper or report.

url.description: URL (for a website or online source).

name: generate_citation
title: Generate a citation in APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard and IEEE
